comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Sold in the UWC Shop (Consumables) for 1,180 UWC. It allows you to change:

Body Type (the 8 male/female models available at character creation)
Face (the three faces available for each model at char creation)
Hair Style (23 styles for men, 24 for women)
Complexion (the 13 choices available at char creation, which can also be changed in-game normally)
Hair Color (the 12 choices available at char creation)
Other (misc. adornments like eyepatches, scars, beards, etc.; there are 12 choices for men and 6 for women -- two of which are unique from the char creation choices and can only be acquired temporarily with Disguise Tools or permanently with Transformation Tools )

Note: the hair styles are as follows.

Women: eririndol.blog.fc2.com/img/seihatu01.jpg/ (Pt 1)
eririndol.blog.fc2.com/img/seihatu02.jpg/ (Pt 2)

Men: eririndol.blog.fc2.com/img/seihatu03.jpg/ (Pt 1)
eririndol.blog.fc2.com/img/seihatu04.jpg/ (Pt 2)

In addition, these styles were added for men and women: www.gamecity.ne.jp/dol/age_of_revolution/product_info.htm (middle of the page)

I know the Special Hairdresser's Tools item had the hair styles listed above prior to Age of Revolution; whether or not that item also features the new AoR options which can be accessed from the Mirror, I cannot say. Perhaps someone else can? Either way, now you know. Cheers.
